notes.title: 📢 SCHiM Out Now! 👀🎉
notes.content:
[h3]SCHiM is OUT NOW![/h3]
You can play SCHiM on PC, Mac, Linux and SteamDeck.

We are super happy to share SCHiM with you all. After more than 4 years of development we can finally share it with the world! We want to thank everyone for their support and wish you all a great adventure in the shadows!

Check out our latest launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=4p8ZWSSAhXY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Save 10% now with the launch discount 🏷️[/b][/h2]

[h3]About the game[/h3]
SCHiM is a charming indie game about helping a lost shadow find its way back to its human by hopping around in the shadows. As you look for clever ways to move around in the world, you uncover small stories and charming details hidden in the environment.

[h3]Key features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]A story of a person losing their shadow[/b] - [i]A schim is the soul and spirit of an object or living being. Everything in the world has one, and it should never be separated! You need to find your way back to the human you belong to, before it's too late![/i]
[*][b]Unique 3D platforming[/b] - [i]You can only move in the shadows, so you'll need to find clever ways to leap into the shadows of animated objects and moving beings to use them as your pathways.[/i]
[*][b]A beautiful abstract world[/b] - [i]The color palette changes in each level to capture the setting, time of day and mood of every location you explore.[/i]
[*][b]Each level has a story to tell[/b] - [i]Each new level has its own living scenery with small stories to uncover, inspired by real Dutch/European cities and rural locations.[/i]
[*][b]Hidden in the shadows[/b] - [i]There are lots of hidden items to discover in SCHiM, and when you find them, you help other schim restore the connection to their thing.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Thank you all for your support over the years! 🙌[/h2]
[h1][b]Enjoy![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/75f91a2d3a875c9abe2565a2b918ddfcb936088c.png[/img]
[h1]Demo still available.[/h1]

notes.title: Shadow frog? Shadow frog! Shadow frog puzzler Schim has a free demo you can play now
notes.content:
The demo for puzzle game Schim, in which you play as a boy and his frog that only exists in the shadows, is out now on Steam. I’ve given it a whirl, and its pretty froggin’ delightful. The game has you progress through different scenes set in a chill, colorful townscape. You can switch at any time between boy and frog. The boy can go anywhere, but is frequently blocked by environmental puzzles. The frog has the means to solve such puzzles, by hopping between shadows naturally cast by the environment. They act like little inky puddles, and simply jumping from one to the other is a rare joy.

Read more

notes.title: Winner of the color palette contest!
notes.content:
We have judged the 35 entries of the color pallete contest!

We were pleasantly surprised by the submissions. Some of them were a bit painful to our eyes but they sure made us laugh.

There was quite a good selection of finalists. We ended up having 7 options that we thought were interesting to test in-game.

[h1]Honorable Mentions[/h1]
First of all, we would like to do a couple of honorable mentions:

[h3]Category number 1: Definitely not a fit for SCHiM but it sure looks interesting.[/h3]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/z0gg]Zogg[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/42efb7446aab2a4d2f1d2dbae55018f919124bb1.png[/img]
https://schim.art/?8000ff,440088,00a238,152413

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198064903393]boatsFloat[/url]

https://schim.art/?c6caff,070064,cc0071,fe3847

[h3]Category number 2: Unexpected interpretation of the contest[/h3]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=http://(https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199106647044)]TheKindex [/url] posted a gif instead of one single image. In the gif, the outlines change color which is something that might be interesting to explore in the future, so definitely an honorable mention!

https://i.imgur.com/E0J7wxg.mp4

[h3]Category number 3: The finalists that didn’t win but got real close (we will consider these in the future).[/h3]

Ewoud personally really liked the submission of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/hiyoricchi]Hiyori [/url] as well, so it’s worth the mention!
